tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Returns the authenticated homeowner profile as structured JSON. Fields include status, name, phone, address, search_location, error_code, and message. Status values are "ok", "error", and "auth_required". search_location is a 5-digit ZIP from address.postalCode (e.g. "22307" or "94114").

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Searches providers by home service keyword and location. Does not require authentication. Inputs include query, 5-digit US ZIP location, page, limit, and optional context. Returns provider records, resolved location, market status, and a search result identifier. Read-only.

tools.name: get_provider_details
tools.description: Fetches a HireNimbus provider profile by slug. Does not require authentication. Inputs include slug and optional context. Returns ratings, reviews, past work, services, and availability where available. Read-only.

tools.name: get_provider_reviews
tools.description: Fetches reviews for a HireNimbus provider by slug. Does not require authentication. Inputs include slug, page, page size, and optional context. Returns review text, ratings, dates, and review sources where available. Read-only.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Creates a service request for a provider slug and job description. Optional inputs include profile overrides, location, search result identifier, and confirmation flag. tools.name: get_previous_jobs

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Returns the current status of a HireNimbus booking by ID. Requires authentication. Read-only.
